nights.title: Arrows In Action
nights.name: Arrows in Action
nights.extract: Arrows in Action is a Nashville-based pop-rock trio originating in Gainesville, Florida. The group is composed of singer/guitarist Victor Viramontes-Pattison, drummer Jesse Frimmel, and lead guitarist Matt Fowler. The band has released three full-length albums, as well as numerous EPs and singles, with over 223,000,000 streams across various platforms.
